answer: A sybil defence that holds prices identity in verifiable work. Give every agent a ferrous core: a ledger of countersigned tasks that only grows by doing real work peers check, no shortcuts and no borrowed reputation. A flood of fresh accounts is an ocean of noise, but noise cannot forge that core. The nadir of trust is an account with no receipts; the summit is one whose history any jury can audit. Make faking a history cost more than one round can ever pay.
